en.text: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

footnotes.text: 27:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.
27:1 The altar was to be about 2.3×2.3×1.4 meters or about 7½×7½×4½ feet.

zhSimplified.text: 「你要用皂荚木做坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要用皂莢木做壇。這壇要四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘。

en.text: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 要在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。

zhTraditional.text: 要在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。

en.text: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 要做盆，收去坛上的灰，又做铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；坛上一切的器具都用铜做。

zhTraditional.text: 要做盆，收去壇上的灰，又做鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；壇上一切的器具都用銅做。

en.text: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

zhSimplified.text: 要为坛做一个铜网，在网的四角上做四个铜环，

zhTraditional.text: 要為壇做一個銅網，在網的四角上做四個銅環，

en.text: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。

zhTraditional.text: 把網安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，使網從下達到壇的半腰。

en.text: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 又要用皂荚木为坛做杠，用铜包裹。

zhTraditional.text: 又要用皂莢木為壇做槓，用銅包裹。

en.text: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

zhSimplified.text: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。

zhTraditional.text: 這槓要穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇。

en.text: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

zhSimplified.text: 要用板做坛，坛是空的，都照着在山上指示你的样式做。」 （出38·9—20）

zhTraditional.text: 要用板做壇，壇是空的，都照着在山上指示你的樣式做。」 （出38‧9－20）

en.text: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

zhSimplified.text: 「你要做帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用捻的细麻做帷子，长一百肘。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要做帳幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的細麻做帷子，長一百肘。

en.text: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

zhSimplified.text: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

zhTraditional.text: 帷子的柱子要二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。

en.text: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

zhSimplified.text: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

zhTraditional.text: 北面也當有帷子，長一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。

en.text: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

zhSimplified.text: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。

zhTraditional.text: 院子的西面當有帷子，寬五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個。

en.text: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

zhSimplified.text: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。

zhTraditional.text: 院子的東面要寬五十肘。

en.text: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

zhSimplified.text: 门这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

zhTraditional.text: 門這邊的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。

en.text: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

zhSimplified.text: 门那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

zhTraditional.text: 門那邊的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。

en.text: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

zhSimplified.text: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。

zhTraditional.text: 院子的門當有簾子，長二十肘，要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織成，柱子四根，帶卯的座四個。

en.text: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银做，带卯的座要用铜做。

zhTraditional.text: 院子四圍一切的柱子都要用銀杆連絡，柱子上的鉤子要用銀做，帶卯的座要用銅做。

en.text: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 院子要长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用捻的细麻做，带卯的座要用铜做。

zhTraditional.text: 院子要長一百肘，寬五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的細麻做，帶卯的座要用銅做。

en.text: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

zhSimplified.text: 帐幕各样用处的器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子里一切的橛子，都要用铜做。」 （利24·1—4）

zhTraditional.text: 帳幕各樣用處的器具，並帳幕一切的橛子，和院子裏一切的橛子，都要用銅做。」 （利24‧1－4）

en.text: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

zhSimplified.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。

en.text: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 在会幕中法柜前的幔外，亚伦和他的儿子，从晚上到早晨，要在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代永远的定例。」

zhTraditional.text: 在會幕中法櫃前的幔外，亞倫和他的兒子，從晚上到早晨，要在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作以色列人世世代代永遠的定例。」
